answer_4.quote: We presented two people with a physical object term, a sentence that mentions the object, and the WordNet definition of the object. We asked the annotators to select one of these four categories...
answer_4.guideline: The annotators were asked to select one of four categories: Used, Anticipated Use, No Use, or Wrong Sense. If an annotator selected Used or Anticipated Use, they were also asked whether the use of the object most likely corresponds to its prototypical function.
